text:
Alex: FYI nightly smallbatch perf CI flagged a regression after the infra roll (cuBLAS/Triton bump). median latency +12%, p99 +38% on seq_len=8 workloads. rolling rollout blocked.
Maria: link to CI job?
ci-bot: https://ci.internal/redwood/eng-runtime/5273 (job: nightly-smallbatch-cuda13p2) 
Tom: I pulled the perf artifacts — flamegraphs show a matmul kernel change: previously `matmul_tiled_v3` dominated, now it's `matmul_generic_v1` at small M/K sizes. looks like autotune pivot flipped.
Alex: exact numbers from the job:
```
workload: smallbatch seq8
median: 18.4ms -> 20.6ms (+12%)
p95: 29.1ms -> 36.7ms (+26%)
p99: 48.5ms -> 66.9ms (+38%)
```
Tom: repro command I used on a repro node:
```
PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=garbage_collection_threshold:0 python run_perf.py --model llama-13b --seq 8 --batch 4 --repeat 500
```
Lee: did we also change KV prefetch/coalesce thresholds in the same rollout? that can change memory layout and kernel sizing heuristics.
Alex: yes, we bumped prefetch coalesce window to 64 from 32 in the runtime config as part of the batching heuristics tweak.
Maria: bisect plan? could be Triton autotune table order changed in 2.6.1 or cuBLAS minor version.
Tom: I ran a quick bisect on nightly images, toggling Triton 2.6.0 vs 2.6.1 — with 2.6.0 we get the old matmul_tiled_v3 and latencies revert. with 2.6.1 kernel selection flips.
Lee: interesting — Triton changed a selector threshold? any open PRs mention "heuristic" or "tile"?
Tom: PR here: https://github.com/triton-inference-server/triton/pull/2319 mentions autotune table deterministic ordering change for reproducibility. seems to reorder candidate kernels, which matches our behavior.
Alex: so root cause likely Triton autotune ordering + our coalesce window bump jointly tipped selection to a slower path. that explains why only seq_len small workload regressed.
Maria: is there a clear mitigations list? revert Triton bump on rollout, or pin autotune table, or adjust our coalesce window back.
Lee: short term: pin Triton to 2.6.0 for the rollout and open a follow-up to test autotune ordering impacts. also add a smallbatch smoke in pre-rollout with seq len=8.
sre-bot: Rollout remains paused for cluster pool: inference-prod-eu until engineer sign-off.
Alex: I'll open the revert PR for the infra image and put the rollback plan in the rollout ticket. also adding a temporary server-side kernel hint to prefer tiled matmul for small M/K to avoid reordering fallout.
Maria: can we add an assertion in our CI perf job to fail early if median increases >6% for seq8? this would catch similar regressions.
Tom: agreed — I'll add the perf gate and upload the perf graphs to the ticket. also attaching profiler output (top fused kernels and device timers) to help Triton triage.
Alex: thanks team — tracking in ENG-1147, marking as rollout-blocker. will follow up once revert PR is in. :thumbsup:
